subject: Contract choreography + onboarding dry-run - Kiosk Health timing proposal
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@kioskhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kioskhealth.com>, contracts@kioskhealth.com
Date: Mon, Oct 18, 2027 at 09:15 AM -0700
Subject: Kiosk onboarding + contract timing

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency breakdown and cost estimates. Legal reviewed the draft MSA and flagged a handful of items they'd like to triage before signing.

Can we schedule a short call this week to run through the redlines and align on a pilot onboarding timeline? Our preferred windows (PT):
- Wed 10/20, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 10/20, 15:00–15:45
- Thu 10/21, 09:30–10:15

I've attached the annotated MSA and a high-level onboarding checklist. If helpful, we can do a focused 30-minute redline triage first, then a separate dry-run with your success team.

Attachments: Kiosk_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf (annotated), kiosk_onboard_highlevel.docx (summary)

Best,
Emma Park
Head of Partnerships — Kiosk Health
emma@kioskhealth.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Emma Park <emma@kioskhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, Oct 18, 2027 at 13:02 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk onboarding + contract timing

Thanks Emma — got the PDF. Proposed plan below so we come in concise: 
1) 30m 'redline triage' with legal/contracts to identify must-blocks vs. negotiable edits.
2) 60m 'onboard dry-run' with CS/Platform to walk the pilot runbook and timeline if redlines are minor.

Internal availability: Kim can do Wed 10/20 10:00 PT for 30m; Jordan is available Thu 10/21 morning for the 60m dry-run.

Can we lock: redline triage Wed 10/20 10:00–10:30 PT and onboarding dry-run Thu 10/21 09:30–10:30 PT? If Kiosk needs more redline time we can extend to 45m starting at 10:00.

Attached: redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx, redline-triage-agenda.docx

—Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Growth, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Emma Park <emma@kioskhealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, Oct 19, 2027 at 10:08 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk onboarding + contract timing

Lauren / Emma — confirmed. I can join Wed 10/20 at 10:00 PT for a 30-minute redline triage. A few notes to keep the call tight:
- I'll focus on data handling, retention, audit log scope, and any carve-outs around telemetry.
- Please confirm which model tiers are in-scope for the pilot (embeddings only vs. generation) — that affects suggested language.
- If contracts@kioskhealth can drop 3–5 bullet highlights before EOD Wed, I can pre-triage and reduce call time.

Jordan — can you have the 10–15 minute pilot runbook summary ready? If redlines are small we should be able to close onboarding deliverables on the spot.

Quoted for context:
> Thanks Emma — got the PDF. Proposed plan below so we come in concise...

—Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kioskhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Park <emma@kioskhealth.com>, contracts@kioskhealth.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, Oct 20, 2027 at 16:30 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk onboarding + contract timing

Lauren / Kim / team — Wed 10/20 10:00 PT works for the redline triage (we'll aim for 30m). Maya Chen (contracts lead) is looped and will bring the highlighted bullets.

Prior to the triage, two asks:
- Confirm whether pilot telemetry will be captured in standard audit logs or requires an opt-in/contractual carve-out.
- We'll take the onboarding dry-run Thu 10/21 09:30–10:30 PT as proposed.

We'll send a short DocSend one-pager and bulleted highlights (Kiosk_Triage_Bullets.pdf) before EOD.

See you on the call — Tom
Director, Business Ops — Kiosk Health
Attachments: Kiosk_Triage_Bullets.pdf
